sites.name: Shackleton-de Gerlache connecting ridge, point C1
sites.note: Mazarico et al. (2011) 'Site 1' (89.45 S, 222.69 E; 89.0% on a 240 m DEM) is the same ridge point. Published illumination depends strongly on DEM resolution, period and observer height (same point: 76% at 20 m/px vs 89% at 240 m/px); compare with tolerance ~10 percentage points.
sites.source: Glaser, P. et al. (2018) Illumination conditions at the lunar poles: implications for future exploration, Planet. Space Sci. 162, 170-178, Table 1 (Connecting Ridge C1, surface level, 2017-2037): 76.0%

sites.name: Shackleton crater rim, point S
sites.note: Mazarico et al. (2011): 86.7% at 89.78 S, 204.27 E (240 m DEM). Published illumination depends strongly on DEM resolution, period and observer height (same point: 76% at 20 m/px vs 89% at 240 m/px); compare with tolerance ~10 percentage points.
sites.source: Glaser et al. (2018) PSS 162, Table 1 (Shackleton S, surface level, 2017-2037): 81.0%
